The Viper Gang, a group of ruthless thugs with fashion sense as poor as their morals, and Frankie's mortal enemies, did the unthinkable-they killed Lola, leaving Frankie with nothing but her memory and a heart brimming with vengeance. No, he had a plan, a plan so audacious it could only be born from the marriage of profound loss and a lifetime of criminal expertise. DiVerge wasn't just a suppressor; it was a masterpiece of vengeance. Night after night, the members of the Viper Gang met their demise. They say he was like a shadow, a legend, a story now only told in the hushed tones of fear and respect to a masterfully orchestrated rampage of death by an aging mobster, and to a suppressor that whispered death, leaving nothing but echoes and memories in its silent wake.

Selected by USASOC for CAG and NSW DEVGRU to replace their former SASS rifle system the SP10M was only orderable to civilians by utilizing Seekins Precision's Custom Rifles Program. Key differences from their standard SP10 line of Seekins rifles currently offered on the civilian market include a heavier profile Bartlein barrel with hand fitted barrel extension that are then fitted perfectly to the receiver, parts are measured pre and post coating to eliminate tolerances issues, toolless adjustable gas block, dual recoil buffer springs, full ambidextrous controls, and a 1/2 MOA or better guarantee with factory match ammunition. Every detail has been looked after and these are the finest large frame gas guns on the market today.
features: Seekins Low Profile Adjustable Gas Block

products.title: SEEKINS BBL 8" 300BLK STS BLK
products.description: Seekins Precision barrels live up to the company's name. Precision CNC machined to match grade specifications from the best quality 416 stainless steel blanks available, each barrel is inspected no less than four times to guarantee maximum accuracy and reliability. Perfect for building an AR pistol or short barreled rifle, Seekins Precision barrels are built to match grade tolerances. Premium stainless steel blanks are precision machined and inspected guaranteeing perfect concentricity and alignment for maximum accuracy potential. Each barrel has a non-glare bead blast finish which is then ArmorBlak coated and threaded for applicable muzzle devices. Threads 5/8-24 for the .300 Blackout. 5R button rifling and 1:7 twist. Made as a drop in replacement barrel for any mil-spec upper receiver. The .300 Blackout has become the preferred round for suppressed ARs. The barrel uses a pistol length gas system. All Seekins Precision barrels features the unique gas block alignment dimple for quick and easy installation of any .750" gas block. For optimum rifle performance, use the Seekins Precision Low Profile Adjustable Gas Block for easy tuning of the gas system for your specific ammunition.

Seekins Precision's MXM Scope mounts are precisely machined from billet 7075-T6 aluminum to rigidly mount any optics to your rifle. Seekins Scope Rings never need to be lapped or altered in any way. Scope Rings are .8" wide to provide more clamping surface area than any other ring on the market. All rings are Type III Hardcoat Anodized matte black for a durable non-glare finish. Built to the 1913 Picatinny specification, Seekins Precision Scope Rings have a center lug machined directly into the bottom. This integral, flat recoil lug is far superior to cross bolt lug designs and fits precisely into Picatinny slots with minimal clearance. For maximum torque and strength, Grade 8 T-25 Torx(R) fasteners are used that will not strip out while being tightened to the appropriate specification.

products.title: SEEKINS REM 700 LONG 20MOA #6SCREWS
products.description: If there is one area where the utmost precision is mandatory, it's scope bases. Literally the foundation for the scope or sight, anything less than perfection compromises the entire system. Seekins Precision Scope Bases are the perfect base mount for your Remington or Savage precision rifle. Seekins Precision Scope Bases are full length rails machined from solid 7075-T6 aluminum to the 1913 Picatinny specification and Type III Hardcoat Anodized matte black. An integral recoil lug is milled directly into the scope base. This guarantees a rock solid mount by preventing any movement during recoil and eliminating stress on the mounting screws. Grade 8 T-15 Torx fasteners are used to solidly mount the base to your rifle. Mounting hardware comes in #6-48 to fit Remington 700 patterned actions and Savage 10FP patterned action rifles, or with #8-40 fasteners to accommodate some custom actions and upgraded Remington 700.

products.title: SEEKINS LOW PRO GAS BLOCK .750
products.description: The Seekins Precision Low Profile Adjustable Gas Block lets you to fine tune your rifle's gas system for smoother cycling and operation. Operation is easy, simply turn the gas regulating screw in to lessen the amount of gas and out to add more gas, then use the brass tipped set screw to lock the setting in place.

products.title: SEEKINS AR ATC COMP 1/2X28 BLK
products.description: The Seekins Precision Advanced Tactical Compensator was engineered to be the most innovative, best performing compensator available. Gases behave like a fluid. Using CFD (Computational fluid dynamics) analysis software, Seekins designed the optimal port configuration and quantity for maximum reduction of felt recoil and muzzle rise. Instead of allowing the first port to do the majority of the work, proprietary front facing ports spread out the gas. This novel port design minimizes the amount of recoil felt and reduces muzzle rise without the need for ports on top. The incredible performance of the ATC allows faster follow up shots and quicker target transitions. No other compensator is as easy to install. Instead of using a crush washer, included is a Timing Nut to make installation and removal for making cleaning a breeze. Peel washers, crush washers and repeated trial and error for proper alignment are no longer necessary. No special gunsmithing is required to install.

products.description: SureFire SFMB muzzle brake suppressor adapters significantly reduce recoil impulse and muzzle rise, ensuring your weapon tracks straight back for faster shot-to-shot recovery. An improved version of the SOCOM762-RC that successfully passed the demanding U.S. Special Operations Command (SOCOM) suppressor trials, the RC2 showcases their years of expertise and dedication in crafting precisely engineered suppressors from the finest materials. You can rely on it to provide exceptional accuracy, as they guarantee every SureFire SOCOM suppressor achieves 100% repeatable sub-MOA impact shift and group size, along with significant sound, flash, and dust signature reduction. Built with advanced high-temp Inconel alloys and stainless steel, and CNC laser-welded for unmatched durability, the RC2 can handle extreme conditions while helping to maintain the reliability of the host weapon through their unique internal baffling, which reduces back pressure. Whether your preferred projectile is the 7.62x51 mm (.308) or the powerful .300 WM, the SOCOM762-RC2 is the suppressor you can trust for maximum flash, sound, and dust signature suppression.

products.title: SUREFIRE SOCOM END MNT TI 7.62MM BLK
products.description: The SOCOM762-Ti2 enhances SureFire's premium titanium suppressor lineup by offering the lightest suppressor designed for 7.62 mm and .308-caliber bolt-action rifles. SureFire engineered it to surpass military sniper rifle suppressor standards, making it an excellent choice for hunters and long-range precision shooters. SureFire's rigorous manufacturing tolerances and meticulous attention to bore concentricity and suppressor alignment ensure outstanding accuracy. Made primarily of titanium, the SOCOM762-Ti2 weighs just 11 ounces while meeting their highest durability standards, so it feels nearly weightless at the end of your barrel. Its internal, Direct Metal Laser Sintered, V-shaped titanium baffle stack provides exceptional baffle alignment and structural strength. The SOCOM762-Ti2 effectively reduces muzzle noise, and their internal venting system distributes thermodynamic gases evenly, significantly lowering pressure impulse effects on the projectile as it exits the muzzle.

products.title: SUREFIRE WARDEN 556 DIRECT THRD BLK
products.description: The SureFire Warden Direct Thread Blast Regulator for 5.56 and 7.62 mm firearms is designed to direct the concussive blast of the fired round forward, away from the shooter, without venting gas to the sides like standard muzzle brakes. This helps reduce overpressure felt by others immediately to the left or right of the shooter. It also minimizes any dust signature when firing from a prone position. The Warden gives a sleek look to any weapon with a 1/2X28 or 5/8X24 threaded barrel, protecting the barrel's exposed threads from damage or fouling instead of a flash hider or muzzle brake. Unlike sound suppressors, Wardens are not NFA items and are available wherever SureFire products are sold, with no restrictions typically associated with suppressors.

products.title: SIG P385F COMP 9MM 4" OR NS 21RD BLK
products.description: The P385-COMP combines the performance and adaptability of the P385 platform with an integrally compensated Nitron SIG-LOC PRO optic-ready slide. Working in conjunction with the SIG Recoil Dampening System (SRDS) and extremely low bore axis, the integrated compensator helps reduce muzzle rise and improve sight recovery for greater control during rapid fire. At the center of the P385 is an all-new modular Fire Control Unit, developed specifically for the P385 platform and featuring a patented Trigger Block design that provides a redundant drop safety mechanism while maintaining a flush trigger face. The Trigger Block moves with the trigger, making it almost unnoticeable to the shooter during normal operation. Unlike a traditional tabbed trigger that protrudes from the trigger face and can create a different feel, the Trigger Block gave SIG SAUER the opportunity to design a unique new trigger system without compromising the performance of the trigger. The customizable Magstrap grip system and ReActive grip texture further enhance shooter fit, traction, and control.

products.title: SIG BRAVO6T 3-18X44 35MM FFP MRAD
products.description: The BRAVO6T-BDX is the most advanced rifle optic on the market, blending the functionality of a premium first focal plane riflescope with the capabilities of an advanced ballistic computer. SIG SAUER's all-new eTRAK elevation dial leverages ZeroSync technology to monitor user input and manipulate the calculated shoot-to distance in the optic's heads-up display, eliminating the need to reference charts or range cards. Simply rotate the eTRAK dial until the displayed shoot-to distance corresponds with the target distance and engage without ever leaving your cheek weld. ZeroSync connects the eTRAK elevation dial with the power of Applied Ballistics while accounting for prior adjustments and providing a custom solution that always represents the current conditions and ensures ease of operation when tenths of a second matter. Powered by a 6x magnification optical system, the BRAVO6T-BDX delivers a sharp, bright image using SIG SAUER's proven HDX lenses for unrivaled performance in varied light.

Advanced Bluetooth with up to 30 Yards of Connectivity to KILO BDX Laser Rangefinders and Other Devices

products.title: SIG ROMEO-X SIG-LOC PRO CIR DOT BLK
products.description: The SIG-LOC (Leverage Optimized Connection) system was conceived during the development of the ROMEO-M17, revolutionizing pistol-mounted optic integration with a low-profile, ultra-tough connection between the optic and pistol slide. Designed for precision and strength, SIG-LOC ushers in the next era of expectations and performance for civilians and professionals with the ROMEO-X SIG-LOC pistol-mounted red dot. SIG-LOC is an innovative mounting footprint that establishes five points of contact between the slide and optic to eliminate zero shift caused by extensive recoil and harsh impacts. The unique bottom-mounted design allows for a longer focal length, dramatically reducing parallax and reticle distortion to provide an incredibly forgiving shooting experience. With SIG-LOC, you're investing in technology that has been vetted and trusted by the most demanding users in the world, ensuring superior accuracy and reliability in every situation. Pistol slides configured with SIG-LOC mounting footprints remain fully compatible with traditional top-mount reflex sights.

products.title: SIG SLX SURG556 556 FDE W/SHIELD
products.description: SIG SAUER's advanced suppressor design, the SURG556, was tested under the harshest, most demanding conditions, and was proven to exceed contract specifications for accuracy, durability, reliability, signature reduction, thermal limits and toxicity to ensure soldier safety. The SURG556 is an Inconel Steel core high flow suppressor. The unique Forward-Flux multi-flow path was the genesis of SIG SAUER's Next Generation line of suppressors. The internal geometry of the Forward-Flux technology reduces gas blowback, keeping the shooter's face out of irritating gases and minimizing fouling in the firearm. The combination of reduced gases and fouling allows the user to maintain a clear site picture enabling longer engagement on target. The Forward-Flux multi-path flow decreases erosion and keeps internal parts of the firearm cleaner, increasing the longevity of the firearm and reducing overall maintenance. The direct thread suppressor is shielded by a detachable titanium hexagonal heat shield lowering the system's thermal signature and increasing maneuverability. The shield was specifically designed to reduce the likelihood contact of burns when in dynamic situations and accommodate rapid transport in mission critical scenarios.

products.title: STRIKE MASS DRV COMP FOR GLOCK 19/G3
products.description: The Strike Industries Mass Driver Compensator (MDC) represents a quantum leap in compensator design. Current designs have largely been unchanged since the 1930s. It's about time for something revolutionary. The Mass Driver name is inspired by the idea of theoretical mass driver engines in space travel. By ejecting mass, an equal and opposite reaction is generated propelling the space vehicle forward. The Mass Driver Compensator is driven by the hot gasses expelled through the barrel after the round is discharged, and acts as a counter balance system to attenuate mechanical recoil. Barrel mounted compensators add reciprocating mass and increase the moment of inertia to the operating system, which can have a negative effect on reliable cycling of recoil operated handguns. By separating the compensator from the operating components after ignition, the MDC allows for close to stock cyclic speeds, and reduces reciprocating mass. The compensator of the MDC system has a widened bore to reduce baffle strikes and keyholing rounds along with a 2.5mm relief cut at the top of the rear to reduce lipping and damage to the face of the pistol slide. Threaded Barrels: Yes, the Mass Driver Comp is compatible with most GLOCK aftermarket threaded barrels. Strike Industries has tested with majority of the popular brands on the market but not all.
features: No threaded barrel needed (but can be used)
Eliminates the need for threaded barrels. 50 State Legal
Widened bore to reduce baffle strikes and keyholing rounds
Counter recoil design, as the slide moves back the comp moves forward to reduce felt recoil

The design includes passive retention and adjustable tension, enabling a finely tuned fit and smooth draw. This evolution of the IncogX features a series of clips that provide more adaptability to the user while maintaining the original goals of improved grip, concealment, and function. A lightweight carrying pouch protects the laser for convenient use in the field.

products.title: SPIKE'S BARKING SPIDER2 MB 5.56
products.description: The Barking Spider is designed to redirect noise, blast, and concussion forward and away from the shooter (down range). It also increases the back pressure which in turn can increase the reliability in a short barrel application where dwell time has been sacrificed for barrel length or the increased pressure is needed for sub sonic or weak ammo. The Barking Spider can be used on any barrel length but it really shines in short barrel applications. The Barking Spider is Modular in that it can accept multiple different end caps, attachments, and thread protectors. The Modularity allows the operator to tailor the weapon system for a specific application. The front end of the Barking Spider has an integrated striking device or glass breaker with 1 1/8" wrench slots for easy disassembly making cleaning and maintenance a breeze. The internals come out the front leaving the body attached to the barrel. This allows you to pin (perm attach) the body to the barrel to meet 16" OAL requirements yet still be able to disassemble the muzzle device from the front. The Barking Spider was specifically designed to handle full auto and high volume fire. The Barking Spider features a cutting edge blast cone design which is supported in both the front AND the rear. This feature not found on any other Krinkov muzzle brake eliminates the cone from sagging in extremely high temperatures. The Barking Spider, patent pending, is 100% Made in the USA and features a Lifetime Warranty!

Their carefully radiused convex surfaces sharpen gouges and other woodworking tools, while their longitudinal grooves make quick work of awls, scribes, and other pointed tools. products.title: SPYDERCO DELICA 4 CPM 2.9" CBLT BLU
products.description: One of the original clip-carried lightweight folding knives, the Delica 4 is one of Spyderco's most popular and iconic models. This remarkable expression of it elevates the design with our proprietary CPM SPY27 blade steel. Developed in close cooperation with Crucible Industries, this state-of-the-art powder metallurgy steel supercharges the cobalt-enriched chemistry of VG-10 stainless steel with niobium, nitrogen, and increased volumes of carbon, molybdenum, and vanadium. The resulting material offers an exceptional balance of edge retention, toughness, corrosion resistance, and ease of sharpening. The satin-finished, full-flat-ground PlainEdge blade of this Delica 4 takes full advantage of these properties and is paired with a lightweight fiberglass-reinforced-nylon (FRN) handle injection molded in a distinctive cobalt blue one of the signature handle colors of Spyderco's elite SPY27 family of knives. The handle also houses the knife's sturdy back lock mechanism and a four-position pocket clip that provides a choice of left or right-side tip-up or tip-down carry.

products.title: SPYDERCO TENACIOUS LTWGHT 3.39" BLK
products.description: The Tenacious is the flagship of Spyderco's Value Folder line-an extremely popular series of knives designed to feature all the key qualities of a Spyderco CLIPIT in an affordable package. The Tenacious Lightweight has scales injection-molded from durable fiberglass-reinforced nylon (FRN). These molded scales cut weight by nearly 10 percent compared to the G-10-handled version and provide better grip traction with their signature Bi-Directional Texture pattern. All other features match those of the original model, including a full-flat-ground 8Cr13MoV stainless steel blade, full, skeletonized stainless steel liners, a four-position pocket clip, and a sturdy Liner Lock mechanism. The Tenacious Lightweight comes with a satin-finished blade and brightened handle hardware, available in Plain Edge, partially serrated Combination Edge, or fully serrated SpyderEdge configurations.

products.title: SPYDERCO TENACIOUS TI DISRY BLK/BLU
products.description: Spyderco's best-selling Tenacious has earned iconic status as a folding knife design. Expressing it with titanium scales and a Reeve Integral Lock (R.I.L.) elevated it even further. Some knife enthusiasts prefer the dramatic look of black-coated blades and hardware. For them, this spectacular rendition of the Tenacious R.I.L. does not disappoint. It combines precision-machined solid titanium scales, a remarkable Disarray handle finish, black-coated handle hardware, and a full-flat-ground D2 tool steel blade with a handsome black oxide coating.

products.title: SPYDERCO TENACIOUS TI 3.35" BLUE/BLK
products.description: Adding titanium handle scales, a stout Reeve Integral Lock (R.I.L.) mechanism, and a stainless steel interface to the time-tested Tenacious creates an impressively upscale version of this popular design. To elevate it even further, this expression of it cloaks the full-flat-ground 8Cr13MoV stainless steel blade in a non-reflective black oxide coating. To complement the blade and provide visual contrast against the anodized blue scales, the knife's broad-based four-position clip and all other handle hardware also sport handsome black coatings.

products.title: SPYDERCO TENACIOUS TI DISRY BLU/SLV
products.description: Spyderco's best-selling Tenacious has earned iconic status as a folding knife design. Expressing it with titanium scales and a Reeve Integral Lock (R.I.L.) elevated it even further. This elite version takes this popular model to the next level with a blade crafted from high-performance D2 tool steel and a stunning Disarray finish on the scales. This proprietary heat-anodizing process is individually applied to each solid titanium scale to produce a breathtaking one-of-a-kind color pattern. The beautifully polished scales provide the structure for the knife's sturdy R.I.L. mechanism, which includes a stainless steel interface/overtravel stop to ensure a long service life. The satin finished, full-flat-ground blade maximizes D2's outstanding edge retention and toughness and is complemented by the handle's brightly finished hardware and polished four-position pocket clip.

products.title: SPYDERCO TENACIOUS TI 3.35" BLUE/SLV
products.description: The best-selling Tenacious model is not only the flagship of Spyderco's Value Folder line; it has also earned a rightful place as one of the most iconic folding knives we have ever produced. This unique expression of it elevates the design to all-new heights by rendering it with titanium handle scales and an ultra-reliable Reeve Integral Lock (R.I.L.) mechanism with a stainless steel interface. Meticulously crafted from solid titanium, the scales have precision-machined recesses on their interior surfaces to minimize weight and are color anodized a bright blue. They also include four sets of mounting holes for the knife's broad-based pocket clip to allow a choice of left or right-side, tip-up or tip-down carry. The business end of this remarkable knife features a satin-finished, full-flat ground blade crafted from 8Cr13MoV stainless steel. A stunning evolution of a workhorse design, this knife ushers in a new era in the Tenacious' proud history.

products.title: SPYDERCO SAGE 5 BRNT LTWT 3" ORG
products.description: For those seeking unparalleled edge retention in an ultra-lightweight format, look no further than this elite rendition of the Sage 5 Lightweight. Its full-flat-ground, satin-finished blade is crafted from state-of-the-art CPM REX 121 tool steel. Renowned for its extreme hardness and edge-holding properties, this remarkable steel features more than three percent carbon and high volumes of tungsten, molybdenum, vanadium, and cobalt. All other features of this knife are faithful to the standard Sage 5 Lightweight platform, including a stout Compression Lock mechanism, nested, skeletonized stainless steel liners, a reversible deep-pocket wire clip, and a lightweight, injection-molded fiberglass-reinforced-nylon (FRN) handle. To further highlight its advanced blade material, the FRN handle of this knife is molded in a distinctive burnt-orange color.

products.title: SPYDERCO SAGE 6 BUTTON CMP LCK BLK
products.description: Spyderco's Sage Series is a remarkable family of cutting tools created to showcase various folding knife lock mechanisms and the influential designers who invented or popularized them. The sixth member of this series highlights the Button-Release Compression Lock mechanism pioneered by custom knifemaker Kevin Smock. A novel variation of Spyderco's high-strength Compression Lock design, it adds a convenient button release to the obverse-side scale. This feature makes releasing the lock much easier and transforms the Sage 6 into one of Spyderco's most fidget friendly folders. Its satin-finished blade is full-flat ground from CPM S30V stainless steel and paired with an easy-to-clean, open-backed handle featuring nested, skeletonized stainless steel liners and peel-ply-textured carbon fiber/G-10 laminate scales. To keep the knife poised for quick access, it also includes a deep-pocket wire clip that is reversible for left or right-side tip-up carry.

products.title: SPYDERCO SAGE 5 BRNT G-10 3" ORG
products.description: Crucible Industries' CPM REX 121 is a high-vanadium, cobalt-bearing tool steel designed to offer the greatest wear resistance, attainable hardness, and red hardness available in a high speed steel.  Created to bridge the performance gap between high-alloy tool steels and carbide materials in demanding industrial applications, when applied to knife blades, it offers extreme hardness and unequalled edge retention. This unique expression of the popular Sage 5 showcases REX 121's remarkable properties in its full-flat-ground, satin-finished blade. To further distinguish its elite status, it also features distinctive burnt-orange-colored peel-ply-textured G-10 scales. All other features of this knife are consistent with the proven Sage 5 platform, including nested, skeletonized stainless steel liners, a high-strength Compression Lock mechanism, and a reversible wire clip that supports ambidextrous tip-up carry.

products.title: SPYDERCO SAGE 5 SALT 3" BLK PLAIN
products.description: Salt Series expressions of the Sage 5 deliver all the proven performance qualities of this popular design in fearlessly corrosion-resistant formats ideal for use in and around the water. Their full-flat-ground, satin-finished blades are crafted from CPM MagnaCut-a revolutionary, purpose-designed blade steel that defies conventional metallurgical logic to offer an unparalleled balance of edge retention, toughness, and extreme corrosion resistance. These elite blades are housed in easy-to-clean, open-backed handles featuring G-10 scales, nested, skeletonized stainless-steel liners, and Spyderco's signature Compression Lock mechanism. A reversible deep-pocket wire clip provides a choice of left- or right-side tip-up and is complemented by a generously sized lanyard hole for the easy attachment of fobs, lanyards, and safety lines. Ideal for tactical applications requiring light discipline, the all-black Sage 5 Salt cloaks its blade in a non-reflective titanium carbonitride (TiCN) blade coating and pairs it with a black-coated pocket clip, liners, and handle hardware. Its handle scales feature both a peel-ply texture and a meticulously machined Caribbean Bi-Directional Texture pattern for an ultra-secure grip in all environmental conditions. For enhanced visibility in and around the water, the Sage 5 Salt is also available with a satin-finished blade and two-tone black-and-yellow handle scales. To guarantee a secure grip, even with wet hands, the scales are painstakingly machined with SpyderCo's signature Caribbean Bi-Directional Texture pattern. This high-traction pattern also reveals the yellow layers of the G-10 for greater visibility in low-light conditions. All the knife's handle hardware is crafted from ultra-corrosion-resistant marine-grade materials and enhanced by black coatings.

products.title: SPYDERCO SAGE 5 CPM SPY27 3" BLUE
products.description: Spyderco's Sage Series was created to showcase folding-knife lock mechanisms and their inventors. One of its most successful members, the Sage 5, highlights our own innovative Compression Lock. This unique expression of the Sage 5 takes that proprietary theme to the next level with a blade crafted from CPM SPY27. Developed exclusively for Spyderco, this American-made stainless steel offers an outstanding balance of toughness, edge retention, and corrosion resistance. The full-flat-ground blade of this knife takes full advantage of these properties and faithfully maintains all the key features of the Sage 5 platform, including a high-strength Compression Lock, nested, skeletonized stainless steel liners, and a reversible deep-pocket wire clip. Its peel-ply-textured G-10 scales also boast a distinctive cobalt-blue color-one of the signature hues of our CPM SPY27 family.

products.title: SPYDERCO SAGE 5 LTWT 3" BLUE
products.description: The injection-molded scales of the Sage 5 Lightweight trim its weight and add the enhanced traction of a Bi-Directional Texture pattern. This elite version of that design raises the bar even further by showcasing a blade crafted from our proprietary CPM SPY27 steel. Developed in close cooperation with Crucible Industries, SPY27 supercharges the proven composition of VG-10 stainless steel with additional alloys and Crucible Industries' state-of-the-art particle metallurgy manufacturing process. The full-flat-ground blade of this knife is supported by a high-strength Compression Lock mechanism and nested, skeletonized stainless steel liners housed within fiberglass-reinforced-nylon (FRN) scales. Consistent with the theme of our CPM SPY27 family, the scales are injection molded in a signature cobalt-blue color.

products.title: SPYDERCO SAGE 5 LW MAXAMET GRY
products.description: Carpenter Technology's Micro-MeltMaxamet is an extraordinary tool steel that was specially formulated to roll red-hot steel billets in Carpenter's steel mills. Spyderco is the only knife company to have mastered this demanding material well enough to feature it prominently in the production knives. The latest addition to the elite Maxamet family is this Sage 5 Lightweight. It showcases this incredibly hard, ultra-tough material in its full-flat-ground blade and houses it within a Lightweight, Bi-Directional Textured handle. All other features are consistent with the standard version of this model, including nested, skeletonized stainless steel liners, a high-strength Compression Lock, injection-molded fiberglass-reinforced-nylon (FRN) scales, and a reversible deep-pocket wire pocket clip.

products.title: SPYDERCO SAGE 5 LW SALT 3" YELLOW
products.description: The most popular member of our unique Sage Series of folding knives, the Sage 5 Lightweight has also proven itself to be a perfect platform for showcasing the elite properties of high-performance blade steels. In that spirit, the Sage 5 Lightweight Salt proudly features a blade crafted from CPM MagnaCut a revolutionary particle metallurgy steel that offers an exceptional balance of edge retention, toughness, and the extreme corrosion resistance we require of our Salt Series knives. The full-flat-ground, PlainEdge blade is supported by a high-strength Compression Lock mechanism housed within a lightweight, open-backed handle with fiberglass-reinforced-nylon (FRN) scales. Molded in a high-visibility yellow color, the scales feature a BiDirectional Texture pattern for a secure, non-slip grip and are home to a reversible, deep-pocket wire clip. Like all Salt Series folders, the clip, liners, and all handle hardware are also crafted from marine-grade materials.

products.title: SPYDERCO BUG 1.25" NICK/SILV ABALONE
products.description: The latest rendition of their smallest folding knife, the Bug, makes a big statement with an upscaled format that includes nickel silver handle scales and genuine abalone inlays. The precision-machined scales feature an interframe design that completely encircles the abalone inlays for a flush, seamless fit. A stainless steel backspacer serves as the backbone of the knife's slipjoint mechanism and supports the razor-sharp, full-flat-ground blade, which is crafted from 12C27 stainless steel. Proudly showcasing jewelry-quality craftsmanship, this Bug sets a new standard in Spyderco style.

products.title: SPYDERCO BUG G-10 1.27" BLACK
products.description: Spyderco's micro-sized slip joint pocketknives have always been much more than novelties. Despite their diminutive size, they are fully functional, impressively sharp, and, thanks to the Trademark Round Hole in their blades, far easier to open than knives with traditional nail nicks. Traditionally, the Bug, Honeybee, and Grasshopper have always been expressed with stainless steel handles, but now these popular designs are available with G-10 scales in a choice of three colors. The peel-plytextured scales provide an enhanced grip and come in black, red, and blue. All knives feature razor-sharp full-flatground blades crafted from Sandvik 12c27 stainless steel.

products.description: Spyderco's Chaparral series celebrates the variety of different handle materials and treatments by showcasing them in the same refined, gentleman's folder format. The newest member of this prestigious family features precision-machined scales crafted from Red Dark Matter Fatcarbon Carbon Fiber. Created by fatcarbon Materials of Lithuania, Dark Matter composite sheets are manufactured using recycled carbon fiber material, biobased epoxy resin, and organic pigments. products.title: SPYDERCO PARA 3 CPM SPY27 BLUE
products.description: For many users, the best-selling Para 3 represents the perfect balance of compact size, light weight, legally permissible blade length, and full-service cutting performance. To raise the bar even further, this remarkable knife is now available with a blade crafted from Spyderco's proprietary CPM SPY27 stainless steel. Starting with the time-tested alloy formula of VG-10 stainless steel, SPY27 increases the volumes of carbon, molybdenum, and vanadium and adds niobium and nitrogen. Crucible Industries' state-of-the art particle metallurgy manufacturing process then ensures a uniform distribution of these alloys throughout the steel for an extremely homogenous microstructure and maximum performance. To clearly identify this knife as a member of Spyderco's elite SPY27 family, its handle features peel-ply-textured G-10 scales in a distinctive cobalt blue color.

products.description: The Spyderco Shaman has long been revered as one of the most capable heavy-duty folding knives on the market. Building on that hard-earned reputation, the Shaman Lightweight delivers the same reliable high performance in a package that is nine percent leaner and features an enhanced grip texture. For tactical environments where light discipline is a concern, the Shaman Lightweight is now also available in an all-black configuration. Available with a choice of PlainEdge or fully serrated SpyderEdge formats, its full-flat-ground blade is crafted from Carpenter Technology's CTS BD1N nitrogen-enriched stainless steel and cloaked in a stealthy Diamond-Like Carbon (DLC) coating that eliminates its reflective signature. Containing almost 15 percent vanadium, its remarkable alloy composition produces an exceptionally high volume of ultra-hard vanadium carbides and gives it the highest wear resistance of any cold-work tool steel available today. To successfully translate these properties to knife blades, Spyderco's CPM 15V knives are also hardened and tempered using a specialized protocol developed by custom knifemaker Shawn Houston. In honor of Houston's contributions, the fiberglass-reinforced nylon (FRN) handle of this limited-edition Lil' Native Lightweight is injection molded in a distinctive brown color. products.description: The Native Chief Lightweight takes the time-tested form of our iconic Native 5 Lightweight and stretches it by about one third to create a longer, even more capable cutting tool. This elite Sprint Run expression elevates it to even higher levels of performance with a blade crafted from CPM 15V. The sophisticated alloy composition of this steel creates an exceptionally high volume of small, ultra-hard vanadium carbides. Optimized with a special heat-treating protocol created by custom knifemaker Shawn Houston, the result is a blade that offers breathtaking cutting performance and edge retention. This knife's full-flat-ground blade takes full advantage of these properties and proudly features Shawn Houston's "Triple B" logo laser engraved on the reverse side. It is housed in a brown injection-molded fiberglass-reinforced-nylon (FRN) handle featuring a high-strength back lock mechanism and a fully configurable four-position pocket clip.

products.title: SPYDERCO NATIVE CHIEF LW 4.02" BLUE
products.description: The Native Chief Lightweight offers the impressive cutting performance of a full-sized folder in an incredibly lightweight package. The latest expression of this remarkable design elevates its performance even further with a blade crafted from Crucible CPM S110V. This alloy-rich stainless steel is very corrosion resistant and contains a high volume of vanadium and niobium carbides for exceptional edge retention. The full-flat-ground, satin-finished blade is supported by a precision machined back lock mechanism and housed within a linerless fiberglass-reinforced-nylon (FRN) handle. Injection molded in the distinctive blue shade of Spyderco's CPM S110V family of knives, the handle features a Bi-Directional Texture pattern for a secure, non-slip grip and a fully configurable four-position pocket clip.

products.title: SPYDERCO NATIVE CHIEF SALT LW GRN
products.description: Twenty-one percent lighter than its G-10- handled counterpart, the Native Chief Lightweight features fiberglass-reinforced-nylon (FRN) handle scales and high-traction Bi-Directional Texturing. Those qualities made it an ideal candidate for inclusion in Spyderco's remarkable Salt Series. This Native Chief Lightweight Salt showcases a full-flat-ground blade precision machined from ultra-corrosion-resistant LC200N steel, best known as NASA's material of choice for ball bearings in spacecraft. Available in both PlainEdge and fully serrated SpyderEdge formats, the blade is paired with a linerless handle injection molded in the signature high-visibility green color of the LC200N Lightweight Salt family. The vibrant handle also houses the knife's sturdy back lock mechanism and includes four sets of threaded inserts to allow fully configurable mounting of a four-position pocket clip.

products.title: SPYDERCO NATIVE CHIEF SALT LW YELLOW
products.description: This Native Chief Lightweight Salt proudly combines the best qualities of the Lightweight Native Chief platform with the unparalleled edge retention, toughness, and corrosion resistance of CPM MagnaCut steel. products.title: SPYDERCO YOJUMBO 3.98" BLU/SLV PLAIN
products.description: Michael Janich's YoJumbo builds on the success of his trendsetting Yojimbo 2 design, scaling it up by more than 20 percent and refining its ergonomics to fit a wider range of hand sizes. The newest expression of this formidable design renders its dramatic Wharncliffe blade in Spyderco's proprietary CPM SPY27 blade steel. This cobalt-enriched particle-metallurgy stainless steel is exclusive to Spyderco knives and delivers an outstanding balance of toughness, edge retention, and corrosion resistance. The deeply hollow-ground blade of the YoJumbo takes full advantage of these qualities and features a fully accessible Trademark Round Hole for swift, ambidextrous, one-handed opening. Its open-backed handle is built on a framework of skeletonized stainless-steel liners that minimize weight while providing a solid foundation for its high-strength Compression Lock mechanism. products.title: SPYDERCO STRETCH 2XL LW 3.99" BLUE
products.description: With a blade just shy of four inches, the Stretch 2 XL Lightweight offers serious cutting performance in a package that weighs under three ounces. For steel aficionados, this remarkable expression of the design elevates its cutting and edge-holding performance with a blade crafted from Bhler-Uddeholm's K390 MICROCLEAN. K390's advanced alloy mix was specifically developed to provide the extreme wear resistance and strength needed in industrial cutting, blanking, and punching operations. The Stretch 2 XL's full-flat-ground blade takes full advantage of these qualities and is paired with a linerless fiberglass-reinforced-nylon (FRN) handle injection molded in the signature blue color of Spyderco's elite K390 family. The Bi-Directional Textured handle is also home to the knife's stout back lock mechanism and a four-position clip that supports left or right-side, tip-up or tip-down carry.

products.title: SPYDERCO STRETCH 2 XL LTWT 3.99" BLU
products.description: Boasting a blade just shy of four inches, the Stretch 2 XL Lightweight offers impressive cutting performance in a package that weighs less than three ounces. For steel enthusiast, this expression of it supercharges the design with a blade crafted of Spyderco's proprietary CPM SPY27 particle metallurgy stainless steel. The full-flat-ground blade capitalizes on the properties of this American-made steel to deliver outstanding balance of toughness, edge retention, and corrosion resistance. It is housed in a linerless fiberglass-reinforced-nylon (FRN) handle of injection molded in a cobalt blue color that is a signature of their distinctive SPY27 family of knives. The handle includes a high-traction Bi-Directional Texture pattern, a stout back lock mechanism, and a four-position clip that is easily configurable for a left or right-side, tip-up or tip-down carry.

products.title: SPYDERCO STRTCH 2 XL LW SLT YLW SRTD
products.description: The Stretch 2 XL Lightweight represents more than three decades of evolution that began with Spyderco's classic folding hunting knives. Through years of relentless refinement, Spyderco have arrived at a full-sized, full-service cutting tool that is incredibly Lightweight and easy to carry. So what could possibly make it better? How about crafting it with a fearlessly corrosion-resistant blade steel and making it a member of the elite Salt Series? Tipping the scales at a mere 3.0 ounces (84 grams), the Salt 2 XL Lightweight Salt is the largest folding knife in the Salt lineup. Its 3.95-inch (100mm) blade is hollow-ground from ultra-corrosion-resistant H-2 steel and available in a choice of PlainEdge or fully serrated SpyderEdge formats. The blade is supported by a sturdy back lock mechanism housed in a Lightweight fiberglass-reinforced-nylon (FRN) handle. Injection molded in a bright yellow color for high visibility, the handle features a non-slip Bi-Directional Texture pattern for optimal grip security and a fully configurable four position pocket clip that supports all possible carry options.

products.title: SPYDERCO CHARISMA LW 2.98" BLK
products.description: Designed by Eric Glesser, son of renowned Spyderco co-founder Sal Glesser, the Charisma is an ultra-slim, incredibly lightweight cutting tool that is so easy to carry you won't leave home without it. Weighing a scant 0.8 ounces (23g), it features a full-flat-ground blade crafted from Carpenter Technology's nitrogen-enriched CTS BD1N stainless steel. Offering an excellent balance of edge retention, toughness, corrosion resistance, and ease of sharpening, the ultra-thin blade is supported by a reliable back lock mechanism and a Boye Dent a strategically placed relief cut in the lock release to prevent unintentional closure. The Charisma's linerless handle is injection molded from tough fiberglass-reinforced nylon (FRN) and includes both bilateral longitudinal grooves and a pebbled texture to ensure a secure grip and superior control during use. Available in a choice of black, red, blue, or gray, the handle includes a reversible deep-pocket wire clip and a convenient lanyard hole. Together, they allow discreet, tip-up carry on either side of the body and the easy attachment of fobs and lanyards. Proudly manufactured at Spyderco's headquarters in Golden, Colorado, USA, the Charisma sets a new standard in sleek, easy-to-carry, everyday cutting tools.

products.title: SPYDERCO BODACIOUS BLK/SLV S30V
products.description: Designed by Spyderco co-founder and Blade Magazine Hall of Fame member Sal Glesser, the Bodacious is named after an American bucking bull that became famous as the world's most dangerous bull. Inspired by that legendary animal's indomitable spirit and impressive strength, the Bodacious is a hell-for-stout folding knife designed for unfailing reliability. Its broad, leaf-shaped blade is full-flat ground from CPMS30Vstainless steel and available in choice of PlainEdge or SpyderEdge formats. The knife's handle is built on a framework of skeletonized stainless steel liners nested within smooth G-10 scales. In addition to providing structural strength, the liners form the foundation of the knife's high-strength Compression Lock mechanism and provide a secure mounting platform for its broad-based pocket clip, which is reversible for left or right-side tip-up carry.

products.title: SPYDERCO BODACIOUS BLK/BLK S30V
products.description: The stout, all-purpose design of the Bodacious makes it an ideal choice for dutybound end users and those who may operate in tactical environments where light discipline is a concern. To eliminate its reflective properties, the all-black Bodacious features a Diamond-Like Carbon (DLC) coating on its blade and matching black coatings on the handle liners, clip, and all other hardware. It is available with a PlainEdge blade or, for optimal cutting of fibrous materials, a fully serrated SpyderEdge blade.

products.title: SPYDERCO BODACIOUS G10 CPM 3.63" BLU
products.description: Designed by Spyderco co-founder and Blade Magazine Hall of Fame member Sal Glesser, the Bodacious is named after an American bucking bull that became famous as the world's most dangerous bull. Inspired by that legendary animal's indomitable spirit and impressive strength, their Bodacious is a hell-for-stout folding knife designed for unfailing reliability. Its broad, leaf-shaped blade is full-flat ground from their proprietary CPM SPY27.  Developed in close cooperation with Crucible Industries, this state-of-the-art powder metallurgy steel supercharges the cobalt-enriched chemistry of VG-10 stainless steel with niobium, nitrogen, and increased volumes of carbon, molybdenum, and vanadium. The knife's signature cobalt blue handle is built on a framework of skeletonized stainless steel liners nested within smooth G-10 scales. products.title: SPYDERCO MICROJIMBO SALT 2.45" BLK
products.description: Designed by personal-defense expert Michael Janich, the MicroJimbo concentrates all the key performance qualities of his iconic Yojimbo 2 into a smaller, more legally compliant package. This elite expression of the MicroJimbo supercharges the design for use in and around the water with state-of-the-art, ultra-corrosion-resistant materials. Its full-flat-ground, Wharncliffe blade is precision machined from CPM MagnaCut to offer a superior combination of toughness, edge retention, and extreme corrosion resistance. The blade is housed in a handle featuring nested, skeletonized stainless steel liners and black G-10 scales. The liners form the heart of the knife's high-strength Compression Lock mechanism, while the peel-ply-textured scales are painstakingly machined with Spyderco's Caribbean Bi-Directional Texture pattern for an ultra-secure grip. Optimized for tactical applications, the entire knife features a non-reflective, all-black theme. Its blade is cloaked in a Diamond-Like Carbon (DLC) coating and its liners, reversible deep-pocket wire clip, and all other hardware also boast low-profile black coatings.

products.title: SPYDERCO MICROJIMBO G10 2.45" BLUE
products.description: The MicroJimbo distills all the key features of Michael Janich's acclaimed Yojimbo 2 design into a smaller, more legally compliant package. At the same time, its critical dimensional relationships, including the cockpit in the center of the knife, are identical to its bigger brother. The result is an ultra-compact folder that deploys and handles like its full-sized counterpart. The MicroJimbo's CPM SPY27 Wharncliffe blade measures 2.45 inches (62mm) to comply with strict blade-length laws and features a full-flat grind for enhanced tip strength. It is supported by a high-strength Compression Lock mechanism and stainless steel liners nested within peel-ply-textured G-10 scales. To balance discreet carry and instant accessibility, it includes a deep-pocket wire clip reversible for left or right-side tip-up carry.

products.title: SPYDERCO EDGERATI GEOMETRIC 3.57 GRY
products.description: The brainchild of Spyderco co-founder Sal Glesser, the Edgerati translates his deep interest in high-performance sports cars into a remarkable knife design. Its pierced, geometric handle was inspired by the frame of the legendary birdcage Maserati, which revolutionized sports car design. True to that spirit, the Edgerati's handle scales are painstakingly machined from solid aircraft-grade aluminum and hardcoat anodized to create an exceptional blend of strength, light weight, non-slip texture, and dramatic style. They also provide a view of the knife's streamlined Compression Lock mechanism, which consists of a stainless steel lock bar nested into a machined pocket in the obverse-side scale. The knife's straight-spined, full-flat-ground blade is crafted from CPM S30V particle metallurgy stainless steel. Available in both PlainEdge and SpyderEdge configurations, it features a textured index-finger choil that allows a forward-positioned grip for enhanced control. The Edgerati's broad-based pocket clip is reversible for left or right-side tip-up carry and complements the blade's fully accessible Trademark Round Hole to allow swift, positive deployment with either hand.

products.title: SPYDERCO EDGERATI GEOMETRIC 3.57 BLK
products.description: This expression of the Edgerati highlights its refined design even further with a stunning all-black theme. Its blade is cloaked in a Diamond-Like Carbon (DLC) coating, while its handle features a matching hardcoat anodized black coating. Following suit, the knife's lock bar, pocket clip, and all other handle hardware also sport matching black finishes.

products.title: SPYDERCO ROADIE XL LTWT 2.74" BLK
products.description: When the Transportation Security Administration (TSA) briefly considered allowing the carry of knives on airplanes again, Spyderco designed the Roadie to fit their guidelines. We created an incredibly popular modern expression of the classic penknife. Since bigger can indeed be better, the Roadie now has a big brother: the Roadie XL. It faithfully offers all the defining features of its smaller counterpart- including a non-locking notched-joint mechanism, a textured index-finger choil, and contoured, injection-molded handle scales. Its full-flat-ground sheepfoot style blade is crafted from M398 stainless steel and features our distinctive Double Dent-a pair of symmetrical dimples in the blade that provide a solid purchase for a fingernail-free two-handed opening. In addition to its larger size, the Roadie XL also adds a deep-pocket wire clip for convenient top-of-the-pocket carry.

products.title: SPYDERCO PITS 2 SLIPIT TI 2.74" GRY
products.description: British knifemaker Mike Read specializes in crafting state-of-the-art non-locking folding knives. His first Spyderco collaboration, the PITS short for Pie in the Sky Read's forum name on British knife forums, redefined the form of this genre. The PITS 2 takes that evolution a step further with a truly unique non-locking mechanism that consists of two integral spring arms machined into the handle scales. The forward end of these arms, which supports the blade pivot, flexes as the blade is opened to provide pressure for its notched-joint mechanism to bear against the stop pin. Meticulously machined from solid 6AL-4V titanium, the matte-finished handle scales are paired with a full-flat-ground, satin-finished blade crafted from Bohler-Uddeholm's M398 particle metallurgy stainless steel. A remarkable expression of Spyderco's SLIPIT concept, the PITS 2's symmetrical design is complemented by a fully accessible Trademark Round Hole in the blade and a reversible tip-up pocket clip to make every aspect of its carry and operation completely ambidextrous.
products.prop65Message: WARNING: Cancer and Reproductive Harm - www.P65Warnings.ca.gov.

products.title: SPYDERCO NAND SS 3.19" SILVER
products.description: From the mind of Paul Alexander, a Ph.D. in Mechanical Engineering and lifelong knife enthusiast, the NAND is a unique new addition to our SLIPIT family of non-locking folding knives. In the closed position, the tail of its full-flatground blade extends from the pivot-pin end of the handle, allowing the knife to be opened one handed like a classic straight razor. Once open, twin ball bearing detents within the handle's frame index the sides of the blade to hold it in place. Together, this Ball Joint Non-Locking Mechanism, hand pressure on the blade's tail, and generous finger choils provide an extremely safe and secure grip. The NAND's full-flat-ground blade is crafted from M398 stainless steel and also features a fully functional Trademark Round Hole. Its handle scales are precision machined from solid titanium and are home to a reversible deep-pocket wire clip that completes the knife's completely ambidextrous design by providing a choice of left or right-side, tip-up carry.

products.title: SPYDERCO SLYM STONEWASH TI 3.42" GRY
products.description: Produced by lionSTEEL exclusively for Spyderco, the Slym elevates Michele Pensato's popular Skinny design with the user friendliness of our Trademark Round Hole in the blade. This lean folder features a full-flat-ground, drop-point blade crafted from Bohler-Uddeholm's M390 particle metallurgy stainless steel. In addition to its fully accessible Round Hole, the stonewash- finished blade also includes a removeable flipper tab and rides on ball-bearing washers for an ultra-smooth action. The Slym's unique handle is precision machined from a single piece of titanium using lionSTEEL's SOLID technology. It also boasts a durable gray physical vapor deposition (PVD) coating and a black-and-white Dark Matter Polar Fat Carbon Fiber inlay on the obverse side. The handle's reverse side is home to a sturdy Reeve Integral Lock (R.I.L.) mechanism that includes a long-wearing hardened steel interface. To keep the knife poised for instant access, the handle also features both a generously sized lanyard hole and a butt-mounted, deep-pocket clip that is reversible for left or right-side carry.
products.prop65Message: WARNING: Cancer and Reproductive Harm - www.P65Warnings.ca.gov.

products.title: SPYDERCO ESSENZA ALUM 3.19" BLACK
products.description: The Essenza is an elegantly simple folding knife design based on the Riccardo Gobbato (aka Raven Knives Design) CHNOPS. Its sleek aluminum handle is precision machined to comfortably accommodate all hand sizes while expressing exceptional visual style. The interior of the anodized handle is recessed to house a stainless steel liner that forms the foundation of the knife's sturdy LinerLock mechanism. On the business end, the Essenza's blade is crafted from Bohler-Uddeholm's N690Co stainless steel and features a fully accessible Trademark Round Hole for quick, reliable one-handed deployment with either hand. The flat- ground blade is beautifully satin finished and has a radiused spine that adds both an extra touch of elegance and enhanced comfort during use. To allow convenient but exceptionally discreet carry, the Essenza includes a deep-pocket clip that is reversible for left or right-side tip-up carry.
products.prop65Message: WARNING: Cancer and Reproductive Harm - www.P65Warnings.ca.gov.

products.title: SPYDERCO COBOL 3.63" GRAY
products.description: Paul Alexander has become one of Spyderco's most popular and prolific designers. His first non-locking folder, the Nand, introduced us to his techno-primitive design style, which combines sleek, futuristic lines with classic simplicity. Spring boarding off that pattern is his COBOL, which expresses his unique variation of the Ball Joint Non-Locking Mechanism with a more dramatic, Asian-inspired aesthetic. The upswept blade is a hybrid of traditional Japanese tanto pattern, and the katana-style point of the Americanized tanto. Precision machined from M390 particle metallurgy stainless steel, its saber ground primary bevel flows seamlessly into a flat grind at the faceted sleep. On the opposite end of the blade is extended into a tail that allows the knife to be opened one handed like a classic straight razor. The handle of the COBOL features solid titanium scales with integral spring arms and seated ball bearings. When the knife is opened, the ball bearings index holes in the sides of the blade to hold it in place. Hand pressure on the blade's tail and a generous choil at the base of the edge further guarantee a safe, secure grip. To round out the completely ambidextrous design, the COBOL includes a reversible deep-pocket wire clip that offers a choice of left or right-side, tip-up carry.
products.prop65Message: WARNING: Cancer and Reproductive Harm - www.P65Warnings.ca.gov.

products.title: SPYDERCO MANTRA 4 CF 3.34" BLK/SLV
products.description: Building on the legacy of the Mantra series, the fourth-generation Mantra 4 is a sleek, stylish folding knife with an exceptionally refined front-flipper opener. In the closed position, a tiny sliver of the blade's tang stands proud above the spine of the handle. A stroke of the index finger against its textured surface propels the blade swiftly and reliably into the open position. Crafted from 8Cr13MoV stainless steel, the full-flat-ground, satin-finished blade rides on low-friction ball bearing washers and also includes Spyderco's signature Trademark Round Hole for additional opening options. The knife's open-backed handle is built with two peel-ply-textured carbon fiber/G-10 laminate scales, one of which is machined to accept a nested stainless steel liner. products.title: SPYDERCO MANIX 2 XL BRN CANVAS CPM
products.description: When Spyderco introduced the first Sprint Run Shaman combining the traditional look of brown canvas Micarta scales and CPM CRU-WEAR blade steel, Spyderco was overwhelmed by the response. Later dubbed CruCarta, this distinctive pairing of old-school, high-performance materials became an instant classic. To ensure Spyderco could meet customer demand when Spyderco applied the CruCarta treatment to other models, Spyderco decided to make them full-line products, not limited editions. Spyderco began with the Para Military 2 and are now proud to add four more USA-made models to this elite family. All feature skeletonized full stainless steel liners, slim brown canvas Micarta scales, and CPM CRU-WEAR tool steel blades that offer an outstanding balance of edge retention and toughness. The scales of all these knives are sanded smooth but left unpolished, so they will naturally patina with age and handling to develop their own unique character.

products.title: SPYDERCO STREET BOWIE BLK W/SHEATH
products.description: One of Spyderco's most enduring fixed-blade designs, Fred Perrin's Street Bowie is a versatile knife that is ideal for a wide range of applications. It combines Perrin's distinctive index-finger choil-an effective alternative to a traditional guard-and an injection-molded FRN handle with Kraton rubber inserts to offer exceptional grip security. Its full-flat-ground VG-10 blade is cloaked in a non-reflective black ceramic coating and carries in an injection molded polymer sheath. The sheath's G-Clip attachment offers a broad range of carry positions and may be easily removed to allow other carry options, including lashing to MOLLE gear.

products.title: SPYDERCO STREET BEAT LW BLK W/STH
products.description: Designed by French custom knifemaker and close-combat expert Fred Perrin, the Street Beat Lightweight is a highly evolved version of his original Street Beat. Its injection-molded fiberglass reinforced-nylon (FRN) handle includes Perrin's distinctive index finger groove that locks the user's hand to the handle when gripped firmly. The Bowie-style blade is full flat-ground from VG-10 stainless steel and has a non-reflective black ceramic coating. To support a wide range of carry preferences, the Street Beat Lightweight comes with an injection-molded polymer sheath and a versatile, angle adjustable G-Clip

products.title: SPYDERCO ARK LTWT 2.56" BLK W/SHEATH
products.description: The ARK-or "Always Ready Knife"-was conceived by U.S. Army combat veteran John Shirley and his friend Sam Owens as a lightweight self-defense tool that could be carried anywhere. Also suited to daily utilitarian use, its deeply curved clip point blade packs impressive cutting power into a compact envelope. The ARK's ultra-corrosion-resistant PlainEdge blade is hollow ground from H-2 steel and paired with a durable fiberglass-reinforced-nylon (FRN) handle. Molded directly onto the tang, it features a Bi-Directional Texture pattern to guarantee a non-slip grip, even with wet hands.
features: Includes Polymer Sheath with an Integral Retention Tab and a Breakaway Ball Chain

products.title: SPYDERCO BOW RVR G-10 BLK/WTE W/STH
products.description: Custom knifemaker Phil Wilson is an avid hunter and fisherman who incorporates his extensive outdoor experience into every one of his designs. The Spyderco Bow River faithfully captures the spirit and detail of Wilson's custom creation and delivers it in a package specifically geared toward budget-conscious adventurers. This compact, all-purpose design features a full-flat-ground, trailing-point blade crafted from 8Cr13MoV stainless steel. The blade is paired with a contoured, ergonomic, full-tang handle with layered black and gray G-10 scales..
features: Includes a High-quality Leather Pouch-style Sheath

products.title: SPYDERCO SHELTER COVE 5.78" BLK SHTH
products.description: Phil Wilson stands out among custom knifemakers. Beyond his exceptional craftsmanship, he's also a passionate outdoorsman with a deep understanding of the design needs of high-performance hunting and fishing knives. One of his most popular custom designs is the Shelter Cove - the filet knife favored by many smart fishermen worldwide. Now Spyderco is proud to offer an affordable production version of this highly refined design.

products.title: SPYDERCO SKOLI 4.68" BLK/SLV SHEATH
products.description: Designed by custom knifemaker Kevin Smock, the Skoli is an all-purpose fixed-blade knife ideal for outdoor adventure. Its versatile design draws on Smock's extensive hunting and camping experience and emphasizes comfort, secure grip, and a well-centered, utilitarian point. The Skoli's blade is crafted from 9Cr18MoV stainless steel and features a modified sheepfoot profile and a flat grind for a superior balance of strength and low-friction edge geometry. Its full tang is flanked by precision-machined, contoured G-10 scales with a high-traction checkered texture. A single quillon (guard) at the front of the handle and a section of jimping (textured grooves) on the spine complement the textured scales to ensure a secure grip and exceptional control in even the most demanding conditions. The Skoli is available in two finish options: a handsome stonewashed finish or a black oxide coating that eliminates its reflective signature. To complement its low-profile coating, the black-bladed Skoli also features black-coated handle hardware. Both versions come complete with a custom-molded, snap-fit Boltaron sheath and a versatile G-Clip mount that supports angle-adjustable carry on the belt and inside the waistband.

products.title: SPYDERCO YURCO GINUNTING 8.08" SHTH
products.description: Mickey Yurco is a retired law enforcement officer, a veteran SWAT team member, and a lifelong martial artist with black belts in three systems. He is also an accomplished custom knifemaker with more than four decades of experience. His first collaboration with Spyderco draws on his unique talents to create a dramatic expression of the Filipino ginunting. Derived from the word gunting (scissors) because of its Wharncliffe-style tip, the ginunting is a traditional Filipino sword popular in the Visayan region of the southern Philippines. Its concave profile provides exceptional leverage and cutting power while keeping the point naturally oriented for powerful thrusting tactics. The Yurco Ginunting faithfully translates these dynamic qualities into a more compact, modern rendition crafted from 9Cr18MoV stainless steel. Its full-flat-ground blade offers a superior balance of edge geometry and strength, accentuated by a harpoon-style swedge that ensures a strong yet acute point. The knife's full-tang handle features contoured, polished G-10 scales secured by eight sets of stainless-steel Torx fasteners. It also includes an integral lower guard, a generously sized lined lanyard hole, and a flared fantail butt for a positive grip during high-speed manipulation. A stunning modern interpretation of a classic cultural pattern, the Yurco Ginunting comes complete with a custom-molded Boltaron sheath with a belt mount.
features: Contoured and Polished Black G-10 Scales

In addition to a worldwide distribution network and manufacturing resources in the U.S., Japan, Taiwan, Italy, and China, their innovation has also earned an impressive portfolio of patents, trademarks, and industry awards. products.title: SPYDERCO LADYBUG 3 LTWT CPM 1.9" BLU
products.description: The Spyderco Ladybug is a keychain-sized lock-blade folding knife that punches well above its weight when it comes to cutting performance. This elite expression of the Ladybug takes that performance to the next level with a blade crafted from CPM SPY27. Exclusive to Spyderco, this American-made powder metallurgy stainless steel offers an incredible balance of properties. The full-flat-ground blade of this knife takes full advantage of those qualities and showcases them with a sturdy back lock mechanism and a cobalt blue fiberglass-reinforced-nylon (FRN) handle with a non-slip Bi-Directional Texture pattern

products.title: SPYDERCO MANBUG 1.84" BLK
products.description: The bigger, more masculine brother of the iconic Ladybug, the Manbug has earned its own enviable reputation for cutting with authority well beyond its compact size. The newest version of this keychain-sized knife takes its cutting power to all-new heights with a VG-10 stainless steel blade that combines a hawkbill profile, a low-friction full-flat grind, and a voracious SpyderEdge serration pattern. All its other features are faithful to the proven Manbug platform, including a stout back lock and a lightweight injection-molded handle with a nonslip Bi-Directional Texture pattern.

products.title: SPYDERCO MANBUG BLACK FRN PLAIN
products.description: The Spyderco ManBug is a uniquely practical folder designed by Spyderco's founder, Sal Glesser. The ManBug is an amazingly handy cutting tool that is more at home in larger hands while still fitting inconspicuously in a pocket or even on a keychain.

products.title: SPYDERCO MANBUG SE 1.91" BLK
products.description: Spyderco's Manbug is a diminutive lock-blade folding knife small enough to fit on a keychain, yet capable of tackling serious cutting chores. When fitted with a straight-edged Wharncliffe-style blade, it delivers an impressive combination of raw cutting power and scalpel like precision. The newest version of this pocket-sized powerhouse is a tour-de-force synergy of a Wharncliffe blade profile, a full-flat grind, a fully serrated SpyderEdge cutting edge, and a non-reflective titanium carbonitride blade coating. Crafted from VG-10 stainless steel, this elite blade is housed in an injection molded fiberglass-reinforced-nylon handle featuring a sure-grip bi-directional texture pattern and a matching black-coated lock bar and hardware.

products.title: SHDW MR920 ELTE 9MM 4.5" THR BRZ BBL
products.description: The MR920 is a feature-packed, compact-sized pistol that is designed to work with existing G19 holsters, magazines, and gear. The match-grade barrel is conventionally rifled and spiral-fluted to improve evacuation of debris. MR920s are also available with threaded barrels, for those departments that allow the use of muzzle devices. The drop-safe, flat-faced aluminum trigger has a 4.5-5.0 lbs trigger pull and a crisp, tactile reset. Optic cut models allow shooters to mount the mini red dot optic of their choosing. The optic cut on the MR920 can accommodate most major brands of RDS optics directly mounted to the slide, without intervening plates or adapters. The MR920 Elite model features directional slide serrations in front, rear and topside locations, as well as a weight-optimizing window cut on the side. The slide top is milled with a multi-footprint optic cut to accomodate most optics.
features: Barrel Material: Bronze 416R Stainless Steel, Threaded

products.title: SHDW DR920P ELTE 9MM COMP BRZ BBL
products.description: The DR920P is a full sized, 17+1 pistol with an integrated compensator built into the barrel. The built-in compensator does not make use of a threaded barrel, making the DR920P compliant in many jurisdictions that have threaded-barrel-bans. The DR920P's comp and slide are machined to give a single-piece appearance, while the novel design allows for rapid removal and attachment of the comp for cleaning. The patent-pending integrated compensator aligns automatically without the need for set screws or other friction devices. The DR920P's front sight is mounted directly on top of the comp, for faster shot-to-shot tracking. The DR920P, which fits G34 holsters, comes complete with features customers have come to expect from Shadow Systems, including an aggressively textured frame with interchangeable backstraps that adjust the point of aim, an extended beavertail, and a textured recoil control ledge. The drop-safe and carry-safe flat faced trigger has a 4.5-5 lbs pull weight with a crisp, tactile reset. The match-grade, spiral-fluted barrel features the patent-pending comp attachment system, which utilizes an easy-to-detach pin system to mount the compensator. The DR920P Elite model features directional slide serrations in front, rear and topside locations, as well as a weight-optimizing window cut on the side. The slide top is milled with a multi-footprint optic cut to accommodate most optics. A green tritium front sight is mounted directly on the built-in compensator and is paired with a blacked out serrated rear sight.

products.title: SHDW XR920 ELTE 9MM 4.5" THR BRZ BBL
products.description: Born out of a custom request for Law Enforcement, the new XR920 is the crossover pistol that is quicker out of the holster with a full 17+1 capacity. Featuring the customizable ergonomics and unmatched recoil control you expect from a Shadow Systems pistol, the XR920 is mission ready.The XR920 frame features interchangeable backstraps to allow a shooter to adjust the grip angle to fit their natural point of aim. The extended beavertail and aggressive trigger guard undercut provide unmatched recoil control, allowing quick, accurate follow-up shots. The frame's wrap-around grip texture is aggressive enough to keep the gun firmly in the shooter's grip without being uncomfortable for daily wear. The XR920 slide is designed for manipulation under stress, with directional serrations in the front and rear (as well as topside on some models) and a thinned profile at grasping locations. The match-grade barrel is conventionally rifled, spiral-fluted, and available threaded or unthreaded. The drop-safe, flat-faced aluminum trigger has a 4.5-5.0 lbs trigger pull and a crisp, tactile reset. The patented optic cut allows shooters to mount a mini red dot optic of their choosing. The optic cut on the XR920 can accommodate most major brands of RDS optics directly mounted to the slide, without intervening plates or adapters. Whether your pistol is your nightstand security blanket or your daily duty partner, there is a Shadow Systems pistol to fit the role. The XR920 is a perfect blend of the MR920 and DR920. The XR920 Elite model features directional slide serrations in front, rear and topside locations, as well as a weight-optimizing window cut on the side. The slide top is milled with a multi-footprint optic cut to accommodate most optics.

products.title: SHDW CR920 ELTE 9MM OR 3.4" BRZ BBL
products.description: The CR920 is an ultra-concealable subcompact that is designed with comfortable shootability in mind. Designed to shoot like a full size pistol, the CR920 conceals easily inside G43X MOS or G48 MOS holsters, while packing a 13+1 round extended capacity or 10+1 flush-fit capacity. The CR920 comes equipped with the Shadow Systems features you have come to expect, like an aggressively textured frame. The frame texture is wrapped around the frame to keep the CR920 firmly seated in the shooter's hands, despite its small size. The extended magazine baseplate features the same texture on the front, to allow an extra tacky point of contact for the pinky finger. The slide features directional serrations in the front, rear for all models. Steel sights feature a blacked out serrated rear and a bright green tritium front, for easy sight picture. The Elite model adds directional topside serrations and a weight-optimizing window cut. Steel sights feature a blacked out serrated rear and a bright green tritium front, for easy sight picture. Combat Optic and Elite models come equipped with the patented Shadow Systems multi-footprint optic cut. The optic cut allows direct-to-slide mounting of a variety of micro red dot options from the top brands, including the Shield RMS and Holosun 507k. The CR920 has a match-grade, spiral-fluted 3.41 inch barrel, finished in bronze TiCN or black nitride. Internals feature a stainless steel guide rod and a drop-safe, flat-faced trigger. The trigger has a 4.5-5.0 pound trigger pull and a crisp, tactile reset. The CR920 ships in a zippered pistol rug with two magazines: a 13+1 capacity magazine and a flush 10+1 capacity magazine.

products.description: The Sticky Modular Rifle Sling is the first modular rifle sling on the market. One sling, for all your guns. This sling will fit most Modern Sporting Rifles, Bolt Action and Lever Action Rifles and Pump Action and Semi-auto Shotguns. The Sticky MRS uses dongles that stay mounted to your firearm. products.title: SANTAN STT-15 PILLAR UPPER RECEIVER
products.description: The STT PILLAR upper receiver is the lightest billet upper available today! STT wanted to create something better, something different. Being better was not enough -- STT needed to design an upper that overcame the shortcomings seen in the current offerings . It needed to be lighter, stronger, and different, and all while looking good doing it. SST wasn't going to settle for just hacking another receiver out of a block and calling it good. The first thing people will notice is the truss pockets. With the shooting styles of today's shooters everyone wants to run 15" & 16" long rails and grip the rail as far out as possible to gain the most control of the rifle. That's like attaching a 16" lever to the rifle. The truss design acts similar to a bridge that carries and distributes the stress across the entire platform verses putting all of the stress on the material right behind the threads of the receiver. The extra strength gained from this design is not only to help the receiver. It also in turn helps improve your accuracy. When most people think of a billet receiver they think of a blocky, heavy, thick design that is CNC machined. STT wanted to break that mold too.

These new models are chambered in 9mm with a 4 in. or 3.6 in. barrel, feature a slide cut for optics, co-witness white-dot front and rear sights, and enhanced flat faced trigger, and enlarged forward serrations. This pistol will ship with two 15-round magazines and comes standard with seven mounting plates designed to fit popular slide-mounted optics. The M&P M2.0 pistol, the newest innovation to the respected M&P polymer pistol line. Designed for personal, sporting, and professional use, the M&P M2.0 delivers an entirely new platform, introducing innovative features in nearly every aspect of the pistol, including trigger, grip, frame, and finish. Highlights of the M&P M2.0 pistol include an extended stainless-steel chassis and a low barrel bore axis for reduced muzzle rise and faster aim recovery. The M&P M2.0 pistol further improves performance with a fine-tuned, crisper trigger, lighter pull and a tactile and audible reset. The pistol includes an aggressively-textured grip and four interchangeable palmswell inserts for optimal hand-fit and trigger reach.
features: M2.0 flat face trigger for consistent finger placement that allows for more accurate and repeatable shooting
Low barrel bore axis makes the M&P pistol comfortable to shoot reducing muzzle rise and allowing for faster aim recovery
Optimal 18-degree grip angle for natural point of aim
Enhanced grip texture allows the user to manage recoil, keep a firm grip and delivers comfort when concealing
New M&P M2.0 trigger with lighter trigger pull
Accurate 3.6" 1 in 10˝ twist M&P M2.0 barrel
Extended rigid embedded stainless steel chassis to reduce flex and torque when firing
M&P's patented take-down lever and sear deactivation systems allow for disassembly without pulling the trigger
Four interchangeable palmswell grip inserts for optimal hand fit and trigger reach - S, M, ML, L
